北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京有雾，体感 30℃。出行注意安全，别忘了通风！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is foggy and feels like 30℃. Drive safe and keep your home airy!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪小雨，风力 6级，体感 22℃。出门带伞，注意防风保暖哦！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi has light rain and strong winds. Bring an umbrella and stay warm!
慈溪.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天，气温 29℃。体感舒适，记得保持好心情哦！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is overcast at 29℃. Enjoy the comfy weather and stay cheerful!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州晴热，体感 38℃！出门多补水防晒，小心中暑哦！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is sunny and hot, feels like 38℃! Hydrate and protect from sun.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳晴朗，体感 36℃。炎热天气，记得多喝水，注意防晒！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is sunny and feels like 36℃. Stay hydrated and use sunscreen!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州小雨，风力 7级，体感 24℃。风大雨急，注意携带雨具！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou has light rain and strong winds. Bring your umbrella and stay safe!
杭州.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京多云，风力 6级。户外注意防风，气温 33℃，别忘了补水！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is cloudy with strong winds. Stay hydrated in 33℃ heat and watch out for wind!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，体感 35℃。闷热天气，注意及时补水解暑哦！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is overcast and feels like 35℃. It's muggy, so hydrate to beat the heat!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉晴热，体感 38℃！高温炎热，防晒补水是关键！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is sunny and feels like 38℃! Stay hydrated and protect yourself from the sun!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天，气温 33℃。出门带好遮阳帽，注意防晒哦！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is overcast and 33℃. Bring a hat and remember your sunscreen!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆晴热，体感 40℃！高温干燥，务必多饮水，注意防暑！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is sunny and feels like 40℃! It's super hot and dry, drink plenty of water!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨多云，体感 26℃。天气舒适，享受美好时光吧！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is cloudy and feels like 26℃. Enjoy this pleasant weather!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳阴天，湿度 87%。体感 28℃，注意除湿，保持清爽！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is overcast with 87% humidity. Keep cool and stay refreshed!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阴天，气温 26℃。体感舒适，户外活动很不错哦！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is overcast and 26℃. Enjoy the comfortable weather outdoors!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天，风力 5级，体感 28℃。风大体感凉爽，记得防风！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is overcast with 5-level wind. It feels cool due to wind, so be careful!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛多云，湿度 91%。体感舒适，但湿度高，注意通风哦！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy with 91% humidity. It feels comfy, but keep things airy!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连阴天，风力 6级，体感 22℃。风大凉爽，记得添衣防风！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is overcast with strong winds. It feels cool, so dress warmly!
大连.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃
